root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The routed file, relative to its root

anyOf.description: A content key: "<parserKind>.<keyKind>.<hex>" (keyKind sha256 | git-sha1 | git-sha256)

blob.description: The content key of the bytes, or null when the run holds none

variant.description: How the bytes were parsed: `json` strict (no comments, no trailing commas), `jsonc` with comments and trailing commas

state.description: `facts`: the pair's rows are held; `defective`: its bytes cannot yield rows (malformed, not text, a byte-determined limit); `refused`: this run could not decide (unreadable, changed under the run, a per-run limit, a worker death)

code.description: Why the pair is not `facts`, or null when it is

projection-data--routes.description: A row of the derived `data__routes` relation
